title: Arrangements for Artie Shaw
summary: His writing for Shaw while ill, Made with the Flaccid Air and Summertime.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: In '44 I did a lot of things for Artie Shaw. I had gotten the second set back with TB about then and Artie's things came in handy because I could
You did something called "Made with the Flaccid Air".
That was my sense of humor in those days.
There were a lot of others but that's the only one he recorded, and he did "Summertime" too.
That lasted about a half a year. I think Woody came after that and then McKinley came after Woody; I think that's the order.
